observations: Two black game consoles are shown side-by-side on a glass counter.
The console on the right has a matte finish and a PlayStation logo on the top surface.
The console on the left has a glossy finish and a different design with a vertical slot.
Both units show significant surface scratches and scuffs.
The background shows retail shelves with various phone and tablet boxes.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE' is visible across both images.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: The console on the right in photo 0 and 1 has a matte finish and a PlayStation logo, which is consistent with a PS4 Pro, but the model is not explicitly confirmed.
No controller is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may have a 'blue light of death' or other hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a game or the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be a different model (e.g., PS4 Slim) or a third-party clone.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.

risks.risk: The controller may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller and a video of it being used.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.
Video of the console powered on and navigating the system menu.
Photo of the ports on the back of the console.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
